title: 90 Valentine's Day Pick Up Lines: Cute, Cheesy and Sweet
h1: Valentine's Day Pick Up Lines: 90 Cute, Cheesy and Sweet Lines
description: Spread the love with 90 Valentine's Day pick up lines: cute, cheesy, candy-themed, romantic and card-ready lines for your crush, partner or friends.
excerpt: Ninety Valentine's Day pick up lines for crushes, partners and friends, from candy-heart cheesy to genuinely romantic, plus fun ways to use them.
intro:
Valentine's Day is the one day a year when being shamelessly cheesy isn't just allowed, it's practically required. Candy hearts, pink balloons, little cards with terrible puns: the whole holiday is basically one big pick up line. So why not lean in?

Here are 90 Valentine's Day pick up lines, organized by vibe. You'll find cute lines for your crush, candy-and-chocolate puns, Cupid-themed classics, funny lines to make anyone laugh, genuinely romantic lines for your partner, and short ones that fit perfectly in a card or text. You'll also find a few creative ideas for delivering them, from lunchbox notes to candy-gram tags.
body:
Cute Valentine's Day pick up lines for your crush

  1. Are you a Valentine's card? Because I've been wanting to open up to you.
  2. I don't need a Valentine's Day. I just need a day with you.
  3. Roses are red, violets are blue, I had a whole plan, but I forgot it when I saw you.
  4. I was going to buy you a Valentine, but I thought I'd ask if you wanted to be mine instead.
  5. Is your name February 14th? Because you're the sweetest day of my year.
  6. Are you a love letter? Because I want to read you over and over.
  7. Will you be my Valentine? I'll even share my chocolate. That's how serious I am.
  8. My heart's been doing cartwheels since you walked in. Is that normal on Valentine's Day?
  9. If you were a Valentine's card, you'd be the one I saved in a shoebox forever.
  10. I saved the last pink cupcake for you. That's love.
  11. Are you a heart-shaped balloon? Because you make me feel like I'm floating.
  12. I have a Valentine's Day question, and the only right answer is yes.
  13. Cupid called. He said you're my assignment.
  14. Do you believe in Valentine's Day magic? Because something tells me we're about to.
  15. I was going to write you a poem, but every word just rhymed with "cute."

Candy and chocolate Valentine's pick up lines

  1. Are you a box of chocolates? Because every moment with you is a sweet surprise.
  2. You're sweeter than every candy heart in the store.
  3. I'd give you my last chocolate truffle, and I don't say that lightly.
  4. Are you a conversation heart? Because you've got me saying "BE MINE."
  5. You must be made of chocolate, because you're melting my heart.
  6. If you were a candy, you'd be a Hershey's Kiss, and I'd want a whole bag.
  7. Our love is like a gummy bear: sweet, a little squishy and impossible to stop at one.
  8. Are you cotton candy? Because you're making me feel all sugar-rushed.
  9. You're the caramel in my chocolate.
  10. Is your name Reese? Because we go together like peanut butter and chocolate.
  11. I'm feeling a sugar crash. Mind if I borrow some of your sweetness?
  12. You're the cherry on top of my Valentine's sundae.
  13. Are you a lollipop? Because you make me want to stick around.
  14. If I were a box of chocolates, I'd save the best piece for you.
  15. Are you strawberry dipped in chocolate? Because you're my favorite treat.

Cupid-themed pick up lines

  1. Did Cupid hit you with his arrow? Because you're looking extra lovable today.
  2. Cupid must be a great shot, because I've been struck.
  3. I think Cupid's been practicing, because I just fell hard.
  4. Cupid called. He wants his arrow back. It's stuck in my heart.
  5. Are you Cupid? Because you've had my heart in your sights all day.
  6. Cupid doesn't miss. Exhibit A: me, standing here.
  7. If Cupid has a favorite, it's definitely you.
  8. I'm filing a report: Cupid shot me and the suspect is wearing your shirt.
  9. Cupid told me to follow my heart. It led me straight to you.
  10. Do you have a bow and arrow? Because you've definitely shot me through the heart.
  11. I think Cupid made a mistake. He meant to send you to me last year.
  12. Cupid's been working overtime, and I think it's because of you.

Funny Valentine's Day pick up lines

  1. I'm not saying I'm desperate for a Valentine, but I did ask my plant first. It said no.
  2. Are you a Valentine's Day dinner reservation? Because you're hard to get.
  3. Roses are red, chocolate is sweet, I'm bad at poems, but let's go eat.
  4. I'd ask you to be my Valentine, but I already spent all my money on candy. Want to share?
  5. Are you the Valentine's Day aisle on February 15th? Because you're a steal.
  6. Roses are red, my face is too, that's what happens when I look at you.
  7. Is it Valentine's Day, or did my heart just get a software update?
  8. I bought you a heart-shaped pizza. If that's not love, I don't know what is.
  9. On a scale of 1 to 10, you're a 9, and I'm the 1 you need this Valentine's Day.
  10. Do you like single-serving chocolates? Because I'd like to make that a double.
  11. Are you a teddy bear holding a heart? Because I want to win you at the fair.
  12. I'd tell you a Valentine's joke, but I think you'd find it too cheesy. Which, by the way, is my love language.
  13. Is your name Valentine? Because I've been waiting all year for you.
  14. Roses are red, socks are blue, I lost one of mine, can I hang out with you?
  15. This holiday is Hallmark's idea, but asking you out is all mine.

Romantic Valentine's Day lines for your partner

For the person you already love, sometimes the best line is the sincere one.

  1. Every day feels like Valentine's Day with you, but today I get an excuse to say it out loud.
  2. You're the reason I believe in love stories.
  3. I'd choose you on every Valentine's Day, and on every ordinary Tuesday in between.
  4. If I had a rose for every time I thought of you, I'd be walking through a garden forever.
  5. You still give me butterflies, and it's been how long now?
  6. Of all the Valentines in all the world, I'm so glad I got you.
  7. You're my favorite plan, my favorite person and my favorite place.
  8. I don't need a holiday to love you, but I'll take any excuse to celebrate us.
  9. Being with you feels like coming home.
  10. You make ordinary days feel like holidays.
  11. My heart is yours, no returns, no exchanges.
  12. Here's to another year of loving you a little more every day.
  13. You're the best thing that's ever happened to me, and I'd tell you every day if I could.
  14. I love you more than chocolate, and you know how much I love chocolate.
  15. Still choosing you. Always will.

For longer messages, our love quotes for him and romantic things to say to your girlfriend are full of heartfelt inspiration.

Short Valentine's lines for cards and texts

  1. Be mine? Pretty please with sprinkles on top.
  2. You had me at "Happy Valentine's Day."
  3. I like you a latte. Happy Valentine's Day!
  4. You're one in a melon.
  5. We're a perfect match. Like candles and cake.
  6. You make my heart skip a beat.
  7. Owl always love you.
  8. You're my favorite notification.
  9. I'm so glad we're in the same chapter.
  10. You're my person.
  11. Words can't express it, so here's a chocolate.
  12. I choose you. Every time.
  13. You warm my heart like a hot cocoa.
  14. Lucky me, I got you.
  15. Happy Valentine's Day to my favorite human.
  16. Will you be my Valentine? Check yes or yes.
  17. You're the sprinkles on my cupcake.
  18. Let's be a pair, like socks.

Creative ways to use Valentine's Day pick up lines

  • Candy-gram tags. Tie a cute line to a lollipop or chocolate bar for a crush, classmate or coworker friend.
  • Lunchbox or pocket notes. Slip a line into your partner's bag or jacket so they find it during the day.
  • Mirror messages. Write one in dry-erase marker on the bathroom mirror for a morning surprise.
  • Card upgrades. Pair a cheesy line with a sincere sentence underneath for the perfect mix of funny and heartfelt.
  • A text countdown. Send one line a day in the week leading up to February 14th.
  • Galentine's fun. Use the cute and funny lines on your friends. Love isn't just for couples.
Tip: If you're using a line to ask someone to be your Valentine, keep it easy to say no to. A playful "no pressure, but..." makes it fun for them either way, and our guide on how to ask someone out can help you plan the moment.

Make this Valentine's Day a little sweeter

The best Valentine's Day pick up lines don't need to be clever. They just need to make someone smile and feel noticed. Choose the ones that sound like you, deliver them with warmth, and let the cheese flow freely. Looking for more? Check out our sweet pick up lines, romantic pick up lines, or the full pickup lines collection.
takeaways: Valentine's Day is the perfect excuse to be cheesy, so lean in and have fun.
Match the line to the person: cute or funny for a crush, sincere for a partner.
Short lines are perfect for cards, candy-gram tags, notes and texts.
When asking someone to be your Valentine, keep it light and easy to say no to.

faq.q: What is a good Valentine's Day pick up line?
faq.a: A good one is cute, a little cheesy and easy to smile at, like "Are you a conversation heart? Because you've got me saying be mine." For a partner, a sincere line such as "I'd choose you on every Valentine's Day, and on every ordinary Tuesday in between" can mean even more.

faq.q: How do I ask my crush to be my Valentine?
faq.a: Keep it simple, sweet and low pressure. Pair a cute pick up line with a small gesture, like a chocolate or a handwritten card, and make it easy to answer either way. Something like "No pressure, but would you want to be my Valentine?" keeps the moment fun.

faq.q: What should I write in a Valentine's card?
faq.a: Start with a short, playful line to set the tone, then add one or two sincere sentences about what you appreciate about them. Mentioning a specific memory or quality makes it feel personal. Sign off warmly, and don't worry about it being perfect.

faq.q: Can I use Valentine's Day pick up lines with friends?
faq.a: Yes. Many people celebrate Galentine's Day or simply share Valentine's fun with friends. Cute and funny lines on candy tags or cards are a great way to show friends you appreciate them. Just keep the tone clearly friendly so the message lands the way you intend.
